title: Cloud Connector onboarding map and inline walkthrough assets
creator: Ayesha Patel
description:
Scope: Design, produce, and deliver a compact, step-by-step visual onboarding kit for the Cloud Connector path used in private/VPC deployments. The deliverables focus on three developer personas: Operator (CLI/terminal-first), Platform Engineer (console-first), and Solutions Engineer (guided install for customers).

Deliverables: 1) High-fidelity onboarding map (SVG + PNG) showing automatic route selection, peering, and fallback paths for cross-region private links. 2) Inline walkthrough screenshots for web Console: Install modal (bootstrap tokens), network checks, pre-flight diagnostics, and upgrade modal with rollback option. 3) CLI-less quickstart flow artboards for non-admin operator (mobile-responsiveness). 4) A small set of annotated microcopy variations (3 strings per step) for AB testing. 5) Accessibility pass: color-contrast tokens and screen-reader labels.

Design constraints: Follow Redwood UI tokens, keep illustrations minimal (line + icon style), keep hero images under 2MB, provide 3 resolution variants for screenshots (1x, 2x, 3x). Provide static PNGs and a single lightweight animated GIF for the network-check step.

Acceptance criteria: visuals uploaded to Figma and Drive, annotated with copy and interaction notes; handoff ready with export assets and CSS token map; PM and ENG sign-off recorded in comments; UX passes quick internal usability check with engineering-run checklist.

Notes: This ticket intentionally scopes only the visual assets and annotated handoff files. Implementation wiring and instrumentation (telemetry events, rollout flags) are separate ENG tickets.
